This is the reason why all under heaven

to conduct affairs without (feeling the)

to taste without discerning any flavour;
to consider what is small as great, and
a few as many;

(The master of it) anticipates things

All difficult things in the world are

he does not lay hold (so), and therefore

The ancients who showed their skill in

He who (tries to) govern a state by his

He who knows these two things finds in

the hindmost place, and seek only to be

It is through this that they suffer

It is through this that they are
difficult to govern.

Man at his birth is supple and weak;

The (part of the bow) which was high is

It is the Way of Heaven to diminish
superabundance, and to supplement
deficiency.
It is not so with the way of man.
He takes away from those who have not

Who can take his own superabundance and

Therefore the (ruling) sage acts without

he achieves his merit and does not rest

Every one in the world knows that the

the strong, but no one is able to carry

In the Way of Heaven, there is no

abilities of ten or a hundred men, there

Those who know (the Tao) are not
